description: Curated meme historian database — ~80 of the most viral memes of the last decade. Each entry carries era, peak year, format, mechanism (why it works), brand-fit scoring seeds, and adaptation prompts for Swing Shack (golf simulator, Johannesburg, coaching, club fitting).

memes.name: Distracted Boyfriend
memes.origin: Antonio Guillem / stock photo (2015), meme explosion 2017
memes.why_it_works: Universal temptation-vs-loyalty frame. Three clear labels map to anything competing for attention.
swingshack_fit_seeds: TrackMan data vs gut feel
Custom fitting vs off-rack
Indoor golf vs outdoor
Coach Cat vs YouTube lessons
R250 session vs wasted golf balls
memes.format_hint: Three-column text overlay; left=current choice, middle=jealousy, right=temptation.

memes.name: Drake Hotline Bling (Preference)
memes.origin: Drake 'Hotline Bling' video still, meme explosion late 2015-2016
memes.why_it_works: Simple rejection/approval binary. The negative/positive contrast gives immediate punch.

Generic lessons vs Coach Cat
Off-rack clubs vs fitted
Youtube swing fixes vs real data
memes.format_hint: Top panel = 'nah' (rejected), bottom panel = 'yeah' (preferred). Bold, short captions.
